description: You are an energy systems engineer commissioning a solar PV and battery storage monitoring system. The BMS controller has been connected and is already sending data to Emoncms at http://localhost (login: admin / admin) under node 'pvbms'. The four data channels are: solar_w (solar panel output in Watts), battery_soc (battery state of charge in %), battery_charge_w (battery charging power in Watts), and battery_discharge_w (battery discharge power in Watts). No feeds are currently configured for this node. Configure the complete data pipeline: create appropriately named and tagged feeds for each channel, configure each input's process list so that data is logged to its corresponding feed, add Power-to-kWh energy accumulation for the solar generation channel (as a separate kWh feed), and build a dashboard named 'Solar Storage Monitor' containing at least 4 widgets showing the key metrics. The system should be fully operational when you are done.
